source.publication: 2025 Montana Individual Income Tax Return Form 2 and Form 2 Instructions
source.section: Form 2 PDF p1 lines 1-8 and PDF p2 worksheet lines 1-13; Instructions PDF p12-13 lines 1-8; PDF p17 tax calculation; PDF p18 rate tables; Instructions PDF p28 Lines 22 and 23, Railroad Retirement Benefits; Form 2 PDF p3 lines 22-24; record reliefs railroad_retirement_subtraction

worked: Federal (given, not tested): federal AGI = wages (person 0) 60,000.00 + railroad retirement (person 0) 24,000.00 = 84,000.00. Federal taxable income = 84,000.00 - standard deduction 15,750.00 = 68,250.00 (federal senior deduction ignored). Filing status single, no Montana standard deduction or exemptions. Schedule I Part I: line 7 additions 0.00; lines 22 and 23 railroad retirement 24,000.00; line 24 subtractions 24,000.00. Form 2 page 1: line 1 federal AGI 84,000.00; line 2 Form 1040 lines 12e and 13b 15,750.00; line 3 68,250.00; line 4 0.00; line 5 24,000.00; line 6 age 65 subtraction 0 x 5,660.00 = 0.00; line 7 Montana taxable income 68,250.00 + 0.00 - 24,000.00 - 0.00 = 44,250.00. Page 2 worksheet: line 1 taxable income 44,250.00; no net long-term capital gain, so lines 2-10 are skipped and line 11 is 0.00; line 12 ordinary income tax from the PDF p18 rate table: 5.9% x 44,250.00 = 2,610.75, less 253 = 2,357.75; line 13 = 2,357.75, carried to page 1 line 8. Bracket schedule as numbers (the expected figure): 4.7% x 21,100.00 = 991.70; 5.9% x (44,250.00 - 21,100.00 = 23,150.00) = 1,365.85; bracket tax 2,357.55. Line 9 nonrefundable credits 0.00; line 10 tax after credits 2,357.55. The form gives 2,357.75; expected keeps the projection's 2,357.55, a difference of 0.20 from the table's whole-dollar constant (253 against 253.20). Tier II benefit on Form 1040 line 5b goes on Schedule I line 23. No cap and no income test is printed, so there is no below or at-or-above side.
accepted_approximations: The tables print a whole-dollar constant with the 5.9% rate (253, 506, 380) where the bracket arithmetic gives 253.20, 506.40, 380.40.
